issues.quote: up 5.4% to $86.8 billion in fiscal 2022 from $94.7 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Apple's FY2022 net income was $99.8 billion, not $86.8 billion. $86.8B would be a decline from $94.7B, which contradicts 'up 5.4%'. The 5.4% growth matches the correct $99.8B figure.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate but has one factual error. Apple's fiscal 2022 net income was $99.8 billion, not $86.8 billion. The stated figure also contradicts the claimed 5.4% increase from $94.7 billion. Revenue ($394.3B vs $365.8B, +7.8%), operating cash flow ($122.2B vs $104.0B), total assets ($352.8B vs $351.0B), total liabilities ($302.1B vs $287.9B) and cash ($23.6B vs $34.9B) are all correct.
